description: The render switches of tools/quality/render_flags.sh as profile data (RFC 0027 decision 18). A launch passes the profile's arguments, then each selected switch's arguments; later console values win. Backend selection moved to profiles (portal-dxvk is a profile, a different tree); --null is the `null` switch. The defaults these switches override (+r_core_world 1, +r_indirect_producer baked, +r_core_runtime_direct 1, +r_core_area_lights 0) are in each game profile's launch.arguments. L1's launch-equivalence check compares them with the launchers.

null.description: No rendering (the null device), for headless checks

core-world.description: The render core draws the BSP world it can (RFC 0016 K5, r_core_world 1, strict); legacy draws the rest. The default

no-core.description: No render core at all (-norendercore): the legacy backend alone, as before RFC 0016

core-probe-empty.description: Core-pass probe at each view's opaque stage: empty (RFC 0016 K5 step 3)

core-probe-seeded-clear.description: Core-pass probe at each view's opaque stage: seeded-clear (RFC 0016 K5 step 3)

no-legacy-ports.description: Native Vulkan without the stdshader GLSL ports (-novklegacyports)

moving-light-gi.description: Runtime indirect light for moved and switched lights (RFC 0011's SDF producer). Off by default: moving-light GI is out of scope (user decision, 2026-09-30)

baked-direct.description: The bake's direct light on the core's world (+r_core_runtime_direct 0) instead of every light drawn at runtime, shadowed

area-lights.description: Runtime LTC area lights (+r_core_area_lights 1). Off by default (user direction, 2026-10-06)

soft-shadows.description: Soft shadows (PCSS) on (+r_core_shadow_pcss 1; off by default)

probe-bounce.description: The probe volume's projected bounce on (+r_core_probe_bounce 1)
